darwin.notes: macOS 1.2.5 build 133: makes shortcut and zoom-speed hints appear immediately, sizes popup borders to their text, removes an incorrect Help link, and matches the frameless Instructions close button to Windows. Includes Project / EXACT FILES scope and search-during-analysis fixes, refreshed external-drive status, clickable shortcut-bar Instructions, REX/RX2 editing and drag export, waveform zoom, and Project Audio Export.

win32.notes: Windows 1.2.5 build 267: fixes Project / EXACT FILES scope and keeps search and library switching responsive during audio analysis. Adds clickable bottom-bar shortcuts, independent Show Shortcut Hints, compact hover popups that follow the active skin, and immediate hints for FINE/NORMAL/FAST. Also includes REX/RX2 preview and drag export, Project Audio Export, waveform zoom, Ogg-in-WAV decoding, and FFmpeg LGPL notices.
